name: Kitchen Chaos(Beta)
summary: NOTE: STILL IN BETA, STILL UNDER HEAVY DEVELOPMENT In kitchen chaos you have to manage every aspect of a restaurant. You will become a chef making meals for customer and severing them. As you progress, you'll have to meet the demands of the ever growing customer count and start automating your restaurant. You can have pneumatic tubes that can deliver food to customers. You can have mechanical arms automate by picking and placing items in right place too cook them. Have Fun! Controls: Y, Switch item to place
